title: Children's Online Safety Policy Template - COPPA Compliant
metaDescription: Free COPPA-compliant children's online safety policy template. Protect kids' privacy online with our comprehensive policy covering data collection and parental consent.
description: Create a comprehensive children's online safety policy that meets COPPA requirements. This template helps organizations protect children's privacy, establish parental consent procedures, and implement appropriate data collection safeguards for users under 13.

sections.heading: Policy Statement and Scope
sections.content:
[ORGANIZATION_NAME] is committed to protecting the privacy and safety of children who use our services. This policy applies to all users under the age of 13 and outlines our practices for collecting, using, and protecting children's personal information in compliance with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and other applicable privacy laws.

This policy covers all digital platforms, websites, applications, and services operated by [ORGANIZATION_NAME] that may be accessed by children under 13 years of age.

sections.heading: Information We Collect from Children
sections.content:
We limit the collection of personal information from children under 13 to what is reasonably necessary for the functionality of our services. We may collect:

• Username and password for account creation
• Age or date of birth to verify age
• Parent or guardian contact information for verification
• Educational progress and learning activities (for educational platforms)
• Technical information such as IP address and device type for security purposes

We do not collect:
• Full names without parental consent
• Home addresses or phone numbers
• Photos or videos containing the child's image
• Precise geolocation information
• Any information through cookies or tracking technologies without parental consent

sections.heading: Parental Consent Requirements
sections.content:
Before collecting, using, or disclosing personal information from children under 13, we obtain verifiable parental consent through:

• Email consent with follow-up confirmation
• Signed consent forms (digital or physical)
• Credit card verification for paid services
• Video conferencing with trained personnel
• Government-issued ID verification

Parents have the right to:
• Review their child's personal information
• Request deletion of their child's information
• Refuse further collection of their child's information
• Receive notification of changes to our collection practices

To exercise these rights, parents may contact us at [CONTACT_EMAIL] or [PHONE_NUMBER].

sections.heading: Data Usage and Sharing Limitations
sections.content:
Personal information collected from children is used solely for:
• Providing the requested service or educational content
• Ensuring platform security and safety
• Complying with legal obligations
• Communicating with parents about their child's account

We do not:
• Share children's information with third parties for marketing purposes
• Use children's information for behavioral advertising
• Allow children to publicly disclose personal information
• Enable direct contact between children and unknown adults

Limited sharing may occur with:
• Service providers who assist in platform operations (under strict confidentiality agreements)
• Legal authorities when required by law
• Parents or guardians upon request

sections.heading: Safety Features and Parental Controls
sections.content:
We implement comprehensive safety features including:

• Content filtering and age-appropriate material screening
• Moderated communication features with trained staff oversight
• Reporting mechanisms for inappropriate content or behavior
• Regular security audits and privacy assessments
• Secure browsing recommendations (we recommend Incognito Browser for enhanced privacy protection)

Parental controls available:
• Account activity monitoring and reports
• Communication settings management
• Content access restrictions
• Time limits and usage controls
• Immediate account suspension capabilities

Parents can access these controls through their parent dashboard at [PARENT_PORTAL_URL] or by contacting our support team.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content:
Children's personal information is retained only as long as necessary to:
• Provide the requested services
• Comply with legal obligations
• Resolve disputes or enforce agreements

Automatic deletion occurs:
• When a child's account is terminated
• Upon parental request for deletion
• When the child reaches age 13 (with transition to general privacy policy)
• After [RETENTION_PERIOD] of account inactivity

Deletion process:
1. All personal information is permanently removed from active systems
2. Backup systems are purged within 30 days
3. Parents receive confirmation of completed deletion
4. Some anonymized, non-personal data may be retained for safety and security purposes

sections.heading: Security Measures
sections.content:
We employ industry-standard security measures to protect children's information:

• Encryption of data in transit and at rest
• Multi-factor authentication for staff access
• Regular security training for all employees
• Penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
• Incident response procedures for data breaches
• Physical security measures for data centers

In the event of a security incident affecting children's information:
• Parents will be notified within 72 hours
• Appropriate authorities will be contacted as required
• Immediate steps will be taken to contain and remedy the breach
• A full investigation will be conducted and results shared with affected families

sections.heading: Contact Information and Complaints
sections.content:

This policy was last updated on [LAST_UPDATED_DATE] and will be reviewed annually or as needed to ensure continued compliance with applicable laws.
